description: This source file defines a memory management interface and implementation for an agent system, including various memory scopes (workflow, session, user, global), and vector similarity search functionalities. It includes an in-memory backend implementation suitable for testing or in-process storage.

classes.name: Memory
classes.description: Provides hierarchical state management for agent handlers with multiple memory scopes.

classes.name: ScopedMemory
classes.description: Represents a specific memory scope allowing CRUD operations within that scope.

classes.name: InMemoryBackend
classes.description: A thread-safe in-memory implementation of MemoryBackend, storing key-value pairs and vectors for different scopes.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Stores a value in the current scope.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the current scope.

methods.name: GetWithDefault
methods.description: Retrieves a value, or returns a default if the key does not exist.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Removes a key from the current scope.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Lists all keys in the current scope.

methods.name: SetVector
methods.description: Stores a vector embedding with optional metadata in the current scope.

methods.name: GetVector
methods.description: Retrieves a vector embedding and its metadata from the current scope.

methods.name: SearchVector
methods.description: Performs a similarity search for vectors within the current scope.

methods.name: DeleteVector
methods.description: Deletes a vector embedding from the current scope.

methods.name: GetTyped
methods.description: Retrieves a value and unmarshals it into the provided type.

methods.name: NewMemory
methods.description: Creates a new Memory instance with the specified backend.
